quarterly_data.quarter: GlobalFoundries press release: GF unveils roadmap to deliver the world's most advanced (10-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GF unveiled plans for FDX Fusion, an FD-SOI platform for Physical AI that it says is designed to be the world's most advanced FD-SOI technology. GF plans to commence manufacturing FDX Fusion in 2028 at its Dresden, Germany facility, where expansion is supported under the framework of the European Chips Act. The first generation is expected to deliver seven nanometer class digital performance, RF performance up to 0.5 THz ft/fmax, and more than 2x density improvement over first-generation FDX. Demonstrator silicon is targeted for early customer evaluation in early 2027, with an initial process design kit (PDK) release planned for mid-2027. GF says it is engaged with several customers on early development and evaluation; target markets are automotive, consumer and industrial (edge inference, robotics, industrial automation, autonomous systems). Infineon EVP External Wafer Manufacturing Patrick Press: 'Together, Infineon and GlobalFoundries are strengthening their collaboration to define and explore future 7nm class FDX Fusion technologies for next generation radar and wireless communication products.'
